parameters.help_en: The version of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster. Valid value: 3.0
parameters.help_zh: AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群版本。取值：3.0
parameters.name: db_cluster_version

parameters.help_en:
The edition. Valid values:
Cluster: Cluster Edition in reserved mode.

<props="china">
Cluster Edition in reserved mode is available only in regions in the Chinese mainland and the Singapore region. In the Singapore region, Cluster Edition in reserved mode can be purchased only on a pay-as-you-go basis.</props>

MixedStorage: Cluster Edition in elastic mode (new version).

If DBClusterCategory is set to Cluster, the Mode parameter must be set to Reserver. If DBClusterCategory is set to MixedStorage, the Mode parameter must be set to Flexible. Otherwise, the cluster fails to be created
parameters.help_zh:
系列。取值说明：
Cluster：预留模式集群版。

<props="china">
仅中国内地地域和新加坡地域支持购买预留模式集群版。其中，新加坡地域仅支持在按量付费模式下购买预留模式集群版。</props>

MixedStorage：弹性模式集群版（新版）。

当DBClusterCategory为Cluster时，Mode参数必须填写Reserver；当DBClusterCategory为MixedStorage时，Mode参数必须填写Flexible，否则会导致创建集群失败
parameters.name: db_cluster_category

parameters.help_en:
The cluster specifications. Valid values:

C8
C32

This parameter is required when Mode is set to Reserver (reserved mode)
parameters.help_zh:
集群规格，取值：

C8
C32

Mode取值为Reserver（即预留模式）时，本参数必填
parameters.name: db_cluster_class

parameters.help_en:
The number of node groups. Valid values: 1 to 200. The value must be an integer.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to Reserver (reserved mode)
parameters.help_zh:
节点组数量，取值范围为：1~200（整数）。
Mode取值为Reserver（即预留模式）时，本参数必填
parameters.name: db_node_group_count

parameters.help_en:
The storage space of a node. Unit: GB. Valid values:

If the cluster specifications are C8, valid values are 100 to 1000.
If the cluster specifications are C32, valid values are 100 to 8000.

This parameter is required when Mode is set to Reserver (reserved mode).
The step size is 100 GB for values less than or equal to 1000 GB, and 1000 GB for values greater than 1000 GB
parameters.help_zh:
节点存储空间，单位：GB。取值说明：

规格为C8时，取值范围为：100~1000。
规格为C32时，取值范围为：100~8000。

Mode取值为Reserver（即预留模式）时，本参数必填。
1000 GB以下步长为100 GB，1000 GB以上步长为1000 GB
parameters.name: db_node_storage

parameters.help_zh: 网络类型：VPC

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period of the subscription cluster. Valid values:
Year: yearly subscription.
Month: monthly subscription.

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid (subscription)
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。取值说明：
Year：包年类型。
Month：包月类型。

PayType为Prepaid（即预付费（包年包月））时，本参数为必填参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the subscription cluster. Valid values:

If Period is set to Year, valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 5. The value must be an integer.
If Period is set to Month, valid values are 1 to 11. The value must be an integer.

This parameter is required when PayType is set to Prepaid (subscription).
A longer subscription duration provides a larger discount. The actual price of a one-year subscription is more cost-effective than that of a 10-month or 11-month subscription
parameters.help_zh:
预付费集群的购买时长。取值说明：

当Period为Year时，UsedTime取值范围为：1、2、3、5（整数）。
当Period为Month时，UsedTime取值范围为：1~11（整数）。

PayType为Prepaid（即预付费（包年包月））时，本参数为必填参数。
购买的时间越长价格越优惠，购买1年的实际价格会比购买10个月或11个月更划算
parameters.name: used_time

fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can filter the cluster list by tag. You can specify up to 20 tag key-value pairs. The number n in each tag key-value pair must be different and must be a consecutive integer starting from 1. The value of `Tag.N.Key` corresponds to `Tag.N.Value`.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多20对标签，各个标签对的数字n必须不同，且必须是从1开始的连续整数。`Tag.N.Key`对应的值为`Tag.N.Value`。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`、`acs:`、`http://`或者`https://`开头

The tag value can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun`, `acs:`, `http://`, or `https://`

parameters.help_en:
The compute resources that are used for data computing. Increasing compute resources can accelerate data queries. Compute resources are divided into Cluster Edition and Single-node Edition.
Cluster Edition provides specifications such as 16 cores and 64 GB memory (Cluster Edition), 24 cores and 96 GB memory (Cluster Edition), and 32 cores or more. Cluster Edition supports resource pool isolation, time-based elastic scaling, and tiered storage for hot and cold data.
Single-node Edition provides specifications such as 8 cores and 32 GB memory, and 16 cores and 64 GB memory (Single-node Edition). Single-node Edition does not provide SLA commitments and requires a long time for fault recovery (approximately 4 to 8 hours). Single-node Edition is not recommended for production environments.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190632.html operation to query the available compute resources in a specified region.
This parameter is required when Mode is set to Flexible (elastic mode)
parameters.help_zh:
计算资源用于数据计算，增加计算资源可以提高数据查询速度。计算资源分为集群版和单机版，其中：
集群版为16核64 GB（集群版）、24核96 GB（集群版）和32核及以上规格。集群版支持资源池隔离，分时弹性功能和数据冷热分层。
单机版为8核32 GB和16核64 GB（单机版）。单机版不提供SLA承诺，故障恢复耗时长（大约为4~8小时），不建议用于生产环境。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190632.html接口查询指定地域中可用的计算资源。
Mode取值为Flexible（即弹性模式）时，本参数必填
